# DatingZen

> Peaceful dating without the noise. Intentional matchmaking with 24-hour sparks and max 3 active chats.

## Overview
DatingZen (https://datingzen.online) is a mindful dating platform designed to eliminate swipe fatigue, ghosting, and endless superficial matching.

## Core Features
- 3 Active Chats Limit: Encourages real human conversation and prevents endless superficial hoarding of matches.
- 24-Hour Spark Clock: Ensures timely, meaningful responses and eliminates ghosting.
- AI Icebreakers: Contextual conversation starters to break the initial awkwardness.
- 100% Free Mutual Chat: Direct connection without paywalls on basic communication.
